title: three stale pkix-chain-simple references in cert.rs doc comments
description: cert.rs line 50 says 'required by pkix-chain-simple'; line 80 says 'that is pkix-chain-simple\'s job'; line 154 says 'while pkix-chain-simple requires x509-cert 0.2'. All three are wrong after the switch to pkix-chain. Fix: update all three to reference pkix-chain.
